title: Risk Top-Up on Card Settlements of Negative Northloop Payments Balances
content:
Because a balance that has gone negative tends to go negative again, Northloop sizes a seller-authorised card settlement of a negative Northloop Payments balance to restore a working balance, scaled by the seller's level in Seller Performance Standing and unreturned chargebacks.

**Rule.** The card settlement amount is the settlement basis times one plus the risk top-up share; the top-up share acts on the settlement basis only, any amount added to the settlement being added to that product unchanged, and the card settlement amount is rounded to the cent. The risk top-up share is 0.20 when the seller's current performance standing level is Below Standard Level or Developing Seller Level and the unreturned chargeback count is at least 1; it is 0.10 when the level is Standard Level or Above Standard Level and the count is at least 1; it is 0.05 when the level is Top Rated Level or Preferred Partner Level and the count is at least 2; otherwise it is 0.

The unreturned chargeback count is the number of chargebacks debited in the last six months less the number of returned-debit entries booked in those six months, never below zero. A window of the last six months takes in the ledger entries dated after the same calendar day six months before the settlement date, up to and including the settlement date.

## Ladder

| Current Seller Performance Standing level | Unreturned chargeback count | Risk top-up share |
|---|---|---|
| Below Standard Level or Developing Seller Level | 1 or more | 0.20 |
| Standard Level or Above Standard Level | 1 or more | 0.10 |
| Top Rated Level or Preferred Partner Level | 2 or more | 0.05 |
| Top Rated Level or Preferred Partner Level | 0 or 1 | 0 |
| any level | 0 | 0 |

## Hypothetical worked example

Settlement basis 500.00 USD; Standard Level; three chargebacks debited in six months and one returned-debit entry in the same window give an unreturned count of 2. The share is 0.10, and the settlement basis topped up is 500.00 times 1.10, that is 550.00 USD. At Top Rated Level with an unreturned count of 1 the share would be 0.
